findings: Local participation can begin while coordinator partition cursors are prepared, before the job is registered as locally coordinated.
Participant execution does not start the partition heartbeat loop used by coordinator execution; long-running participant work can be reclaimed.
Partition progress and heartbeat updates lack original-owner guards; terminal updates only require PROCESSING and can accept a stale claim.
Worker shutdown skips executors that have begun shutdown but still contain running tasks.
interpretation: Counts, query responses, cancellation isolation, and restart persistence passed. These timings include duplicate local participation and partition retries; they do not establish performance for the intended three-worker configuration after the lease fix.
